match.title: South Africa vs Namibia
match.h2h: 🏏 Cricket Historically, South Africa has rarely fielded its senior men's team against Namibia in formal bilaterals. However, the teams met in a historic senior One-off T20 I fixture, where Namibia pulled off an upset. Total T20 I Matches: 1 South Africa Wins: 0 Namibia Wins: 1 Last Meeting: Namibia defeated South Africa by 4 wickets at the Namibia Cricket Ground.
